A Premium Reference

One thousand everyday expressions, in two languages and in context.

A curated reference of the phrases that shape daily conversation — each rendered in English and Portuguese, then placed inside an authored example that shows how it actually lives in the world.

Conversation, in practice
§
Editor's Note

Language lives in the moments between dictionary definitions.

A phrase like "I'll be right back" means little when read in isolation. Inside a real exchange — keys jangling, a friend half-listening — it becomes a small contract. That is what this volume tries to honor: not just the words, but where they breathe. Each entry pairs the expression with its Portuguese counterpart, an authored sentence that places it in living use, and audio pronunciation in both languages so the ear can learn alongside the eye.

About this Volume

A bilingual compendium for those who believe language is best learned in situ — phrase by phrase, scene by scene.

Method

Each expression is paired with a parallel Portuguese translation, then re-rendered inside an authored contextual sentence. The aim is not exhaustive coverage but lived fluency.

Range

From the simplest greeting to the kind of phrase one carries through a lifetime — organized in ten themed chapters of one hundred entries each.

Crafted by Brice Gadou Business English Expert
